metadataRaw.title: Easy Back Strengthening Exercises for Seniors and Beginners
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows straightforward exercises focused on improving balance, coordination, stability, and strength throughout the whole back.

These exercises are designed for beginners and seniors, so we'll keep it simple with no awkward or complex movements. 

As a bonus, all of these back strengthening exercises can be done at home and require no special equipment.

Watch now for easy back strengthening exercises for seniors and beginners!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:45 Next Level Bridge
3:47 Full Body Bridge
4:34 Upper Back Strengthening
5:45 Dead Bug
7:29 3D Dead Bug
8:30 Bird Dog
10:14 Hip Hiker
11:56 Knee Raiser
